component.name: Rollcopy
component.summary: Copy photos and videos from your iPhone over USB

description.p: Plug in your iPhone, pick photos and videos, and get files that open everywhere: HEIC becomes JPG and MOV becomes MP4 (lossless), arranged by the date each item was taken.

ul.li: Browse the library by year and month, with thumbnails and details
Edited photos are copied as edited; Live Photos as stills
Shows what is already copied, so you only copy what's new
Read-only towards the phone: it never changes or deletes anything there
Works offline; no account or cloud needed

screenshot.caption: The library with the preview pane

description.p: Title bar and window buttons on GNOME (Wayland), such as Ubuntu; toolbar buttons no longer pushed out of view in narrow windows.
